video_title: Rudy Gay Clears the Air on His Raptors Tenure, Kyle Lowry & Pascal Siakam | Hoop There It Is

quotes.speaker: Rudy Gay
quotes.summary_phrase: Rudy Gay on his short but meaningful time with Toronto
quotes.excerpt: I never felt like I had a chance to really, really show love like I wanted to.
quotes.quote: My time in Toronto was short, but it was a great time for me. I met some good teammates and I never felt like I had a chance to really, really show love like I wanted to. So, it's good to get back and be a part of the new, old, and improved Toronto Raptors.

quotes.speaker: Rudy Gay
quotes.summary_phrase: Rudy Gay on why he chose to return to Toronto
quotes.excerpt: if there was any way for him to go it would be in Toronto and playing the Raptors uniform.
quotes.quote: It was a surprise to me, but if there was any way for him to go it would be in Toronto and playing the Raptors uniform. He's the guy that did a lot for that organization and I guess he just wanted to go back and get some more love.

quotes.speaker: Rudy Gay
quotes.summary_phrase: Rudy Gay on playing through injuries during his career
quotes.excerpt: none of us are perfect, but that's the thing about athletes, you figure out how to play around
quotes.quote: I just remember not even knowing about it until I got traded to Toronto. We went through so much of a process to figure everything out. None of us are perfect, but that's the thing about athletes, you figure out how to play around some of the effects you may have and injuries and all that stuff. I didn't think much of it, but I was glad I found it and it just helped me progress in my career.

quotes.speaker: Rudy Gay
quotes.summary_phrase: Rudy Gay on the difficulty of his trade to Toronto
quotes.excerpt: I made the complete move to Toronto and tried to lay a foundation.
quotes.quote: It was a tough process. I went to Toronto, that was supposed to be my home. I made the complete move to Toronto and tried to lay a foundation. Obviously, things with the organization didn't work out, but it is a tough thing. I think things are different now, things have changed, a little easier now, but at that point, you couldn't even use the same phone.

quotes.speaker: Rudy Gay
quotes.summary_phrase: Rudy Gay clarifies his comments about being traded to Toronto
quotes.excerpt: it wasn't a knock on Toronto, it's just one, I didn't really understand the process with Memphis trading me.
quotes.quote: It wasn't a knock on Toronto, it's just one, I didn't really understand the process with Memphis trading me. When you think about your choice of playing, no disrespect to Toronto, but you have Miami, you have your New York, you have your LA. I didn't choose to go anywhere, they traded for me, so I made the most out of it and had some great time in Toronto.

quotes.speaker: Rudy Gay
quotes.summary_phrase: Rudy Gay on his leadership style and shot selection
quotes.excerpt: it was part of my leadership skills and I think it came off a little bad
quotes.quote: It was funny because it wasn't that as much. It was part of my leadership skills and I think it came off a little bad because there will be a couple of games where I try to shoot us back into the game, but for the most part, we're not playing for stats, we're just playing to win. I talked to coach about it and he said that was one of the things that he wanted to implement and I just tried to be a leader on the team and implement it.

quotes.speaker: Rudy Gay
quotes.summary_phrase: Rudy Gay on his close relationship with DeMar DeRozan
quotes.excerpt: it was just like an ironic laugh of like, damn, I'm playing with you again.
quotes.quote: Everybody knows like me, Kyle, and DeMar are really, really close. It got to a point where it was after the playoff series where it kind of was kind of iffy if DeMar would be there and I think he kind of understood or felt like something was going to happen. It wasn't a laughing at him, it was just like an ironic laugh of like, damn, I'm playing with you again.

quotes.speaker: Rudy Gay
quotes.summary_phrase: Rudy Gay on Kyle Lowry's leadership and determination
quotes.excerpt: Kyle is a Taurus, they're going to figure out what they want, they're going to do whatever it takes
quotes.quote: Kyle is a Taurus, they're going to figure out what they want, they're going to do whatever it takes to get it. And that just sums up Kyle in a nutshell. I learned a lot from him, I learned a lot from just watching him after we played together because this is a guy that got drafted to the same team. This is a guy even before that in college, tore his ACL a year before, like before the season and played halfway through the season, which is insane. That just shows the mindset he had and he's not going to be stopped.

quotes.speaker: Rudy Gay
quotes.summary_phrase: Rudy Gay on the difficulty of retiring from basketball
quotes.excerpt: I was nervous because for most of my life, more than not, I've been a basketball player.
quotes.quote: A little bit of both. I was nervous because for most of my life, more than not, I've been a basketball player and I didn't know what it would be like not to be one. So that was nerve-wracking for me. In top of that, I don't think anybody that retires is ready to give it up. Deep down inside, but I think for the most part, most of us understand when you should.

quotes.speaker: Rudy Gay
quotes.summary_phrase: Rudy Gay on the challenges of longevity in the NBA
quotes.excerpt: to be able to withstand different eras and different things going on and be consistent
quotes.quote: To be able to withstand different eras and different things going on and be consistent and continue to work and continue to change your game, continue to have to be focused enough to stay with them, the means of what you need. There's locker room turnover, players are getting younger. When you're in the locker room pushing 40 and you have a 19-year-old, you have to find a way to get to them and understand them.

quotes.speaker: Rudy Gay
quotes.summary_phrase: Rudy Gay on the impact of Pascal Siakam's foundation
quotes.excerpt: they're creating something that that's not seen and that's going to help the next generation
quotes.quote: They've already won, like they're creating something that that's not seen and that's going to help the next generation no matter if they win or not. So I'm just glad to be a part of it.

quotes.speaker: Rudy Gay
quotes.summary_phrase: Rudy Gay on his appreciation for Frank Sinatra's music
quotes.excerpt: he embodies a man's perspective of life through his music.
quotes.quote: I'm a huge Frank Sinatra fan. I think he embodies a man's perspective of life through his music. I really relate to a lot of his songs and I listen to it and I think I had a wine cork by it too, so I was enjoying some wine too. So those are two things I like to do.

quotes.speaker: Rudy Gay
quotes.summary_phrase: Rudy Gay on his experience as a judge for Siakam's foundation
quotes.excerpt: it was different, but I think I really got into it
quotes.quote: It was pretty, it was different, but I think I really got into it. We were in there deliberating and talking about the founders and the stuff that can give us a tough job because all the companies are super amazing and the work that they've done is in different sectors and helping kids, helping teachers in all different ways. I thought I was going to come in there and maybe I'll have the code, I'm like, do most of the things, but I was actually in there arguing with her on like who we need to be doing what we need to be doing.

quotes.speaker: Rudy Gay
quotes.summary_phrase: Rudy Gay on the importance of supporting teachers
quotes.excerpt: we want to help kids and we want to make sure that they get the future
quotes.quote: It's awesome to see and they speak on different things. I've seen all the other ones, especially in the core one, there was a lot of things like with helping kids, just to name one, like English Island and different things like that that we saw. And I think now it's even to see like stuff that to help the teachers because sometimes we want to help kids and we want to make sure that they get the future that they deserve, but I think we can also help them through the teachers and the teachers are a big part of that.

quotes.speaker: Rudy Gay
quotes.summary_phrase: Rudy Gay on the origins of his foundation
quotes.excerpt: Ralph Lean was like a such a big part of like me starting the foundation
quotes.quote: It's pretty crazy because I remember which is again, he's the reason why we are all where we are. Ralph Lean was like a such a big part of like me starting the foundation and he's the first person I talked to about it. I had this idea and I wanted to be different, not wanting to do things the way that everyone does it and he's the first person to bring me in and teach me how it's done.

quotes.speaker: Rudy Gay
quotes.summary_phrase: Rudy Gay on the impact of his foundation's work
quotes.excerpt: it's pretty cool and to have that I already know what it's like so it wasn't like
quotes.quote: It's pretty cool and the guys on the team at PS43, they show me sometimes the email that we still receive from teachers, from students, and from people that we've helped in the past and it's amazing. You couldn't really predict this, obviously you know you're going to help people, but to see the impact and knowing that what it means to them is everything.

quotes.speaker: Rudy Gay
quotes.summary_phrase: Rudy Gay on his love for Shark Tank
quotes.excerpt: I love Shark Tank, like I actually watch Shark Tank every day.
quotes.quote: I love Shark Tank, like I actually watch Shark Tank every day. Obviously getting older, you start to wanting to do things other than basketball and I think just the opportunity that it gives people and founders is such a great platform to see.

quotes.speaker: Rudy Gay
quotes.summary_phrase: Rudy Gay on his relationship with Terrence Ross
quotes.excerpt: when you name Kyle, you name DeMar, like those are the guys that taught me how
quotes.quote: Kyle is awesome, obviously my beloved. He's one of the guys that when you name Kyle, you name DeMar, like those are the guys that taught me how to be a professional. So I'll always be grateful to them for just showing us the way without trying, without really being talking too much but just like showing how it's done.
